description: Defines the Character class representing special characters in paragraph text within the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including predefined static instances for common symbols and serialization logic.

classes.name: Character
classes.description: Represents a special character in paragraph text, with properties for symbol name, character, count, and serialization logic.

classes.name: Character.CharacterValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for Character, including SymbolName and Count.

methods.name: Character.get_Char
methods.description: Gets the character representation of SymbolName.

methods.name: Character.set_Char
methods.description: Sets the SymbolName from a character.

methods.name: Character.get_Count
methods.description: Gets the repeat count of the character.

methods.name: Character.set_Count
methods.description: Sets the repeat count of the character.

methods.name: Character.Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Character object into DDL format.

methods.name: Character.Meta
methods.description: Returns meta information about the Character class.
